evals.prompt: I need to connect Spice to my PostgreSQL database running on localhost. The table is public.users. My credentials are in environment variables PG_USER and PG_PASS.
evals.expected_output: Dataset config with from: postgres:public.users, pg_host, pg_port, and secret references for credentials

assertions.name: correct_from_format
assertions.description: Should use correct postgres from format

assertions.name: references_env_secrets
assertions.description: Should reference environment variables for credentials

evals.prompt: I have a folder of markdown files documenting our architecture decisions. I want to load them into Spice so I can search over them later.
evals.expected_output: Use file connector with file_format: md, produces location and content columns

assertions.name: mentions_content_column
assertions.description: Should mention the content column produced by document formats

evals.prompt: What connectors does Spice support? I'm trying to figure out if I can connect to Snowflake and also read from Kafka topics.
evals.expected_output: List supported connectors, confirm Snowflake (Release Candidate) and Kafka (Alpha) with from formats

assertions.name: mentions_snowflake
assertions.description: Should mention Snowflake connector and format

assertions.name: mentions_kafka
assertions.description: Should mention Kafka connector and format
